name: Absencium
description: A student organiser for missed-class notes, attendance, reminders, assignments, and academic planning.
privacySummary: Designed around local-first storage. Optional online AI features, if included in a release, may send selected content to the configured provider. Check the current release and privacy documentation before using those features.

dataSafety.title: Local storage
dataSafety.content: The intended design stores notes and academic information locally on the device.

dataSafety.title: Optional AI features
dataSafety.content: If enabled in a release, AI features may transmit the content you choose to submit to the configured service. Review the current app settings and provider terms.

dataSafety.title: Accounts and advertising
dataSafety.content: This website does not claim that every future app version has been independently audited. Check the source code and release documentation for the behavior of the version you install.

features.title: Notes vault
features.content: Organise notes by subject and date, with support for written entries and a place for missed-class material.

features.title: Attendance
features.content: Plan to track present and absent days, attendance percentage, and a configurable attendance overview.

features.title: Reminders
features.content: Organise assignment deadlines, homework, and important academic tasks.

features.title: Calendar
features.content: View academic dates and manage holidays and other schedule changes.

features.title: Offline-first approach
features.content: Designed to keep core student organisation features useful without requiring a cloud account.

details.title: App overview
details.content: Absencium is being developed as a student companion for organising academic life. Features described here represent the intended project direction; availability depends on the published build.

details.title: Compatibility
details.content: Android application. The supported Android versions and device requirements will be listed once verified against a published release.

details.title: Permissions
details.content: Permissions depend on enabled features and the released build. Review the Android permission prompts and source code before granting access.

details.title: Licence and source
details.content: The project repository declares GPL-3.0. Review the repository's current LICENSE and third-party notices for the exact terms and attribution requirements.
